overview: The Esplanade is a family-oriented hotel looking straight over Fistral Beach in Newquay, a few minutes' walk from the sand. Rooms include couples rooms, such as the surf-inspired Roxy and Quiksilver rooms, and family rooms sleeping 3 to 6. Facilities include a heated indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, children's pool, a 30-seat cinema and indoor and outdoor play areas. The Cove Restaurant serves seasonal modern British and European menus with Cornish produce, and Elements Cocktail Bar has a terrace. The Quiksilver Surf School overlooks the south end of Fistral and offers guests discounted lessons. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options are available if you tell the hotel in advance. On-site parking is limited, so reserve it when you book. Dogs are allowed in selected rooms for £15 per dog per night, with a self-service dog wash. Surfbooker stayed in the Roxy room and has reviewed it below.
